note: De-identified research record. Only patients whose research consent was recorded by the physiotherapist are included. There are no names, phone numbers, e-mail addresses, cities or free text; dates are months; ages are 10-year bands; the study id is the patient's RehabVerse reference code (a random code, not derived from any personal detail). Every export is written to the audit log.

participants.title: Participants
columns: Study id: the patient's RehabVerse reference code (a random code)
Age in 10-year bands (18-19 shown as 10-19); 70+ for 70 and over
As entered at registration (may be empty)
Areas reported in the latest assessment, joined with |
Safety-screening level of the latest assessment: none, urgent or emergency
Pain now (0-10) in the latest assessment
How long the problem had lasted (lt_1w, 1_4w, 1_3m, 3_6m, gt_6m)
Latest programme status (active, paused, completed, discontinued)
Exercise days in the programme (not cancelled)
Days with feedback where the patient did something (completion all or partial)
AI assistance setting chosen by the physiotherapist: off or on

screening.title: Symptom screening
columns: Study id: the patient's RehabVerse reference code (a random code)
Version of the screening engine that scored the answers (changes when any question, pattern or weight changes)
checker (answered inside RehabVerse) or handover (answers carried from the public symptom checker)
Language the questions were shown in: en or ru (Roman Urdu)
Every answer id, sorted, joined with |
Best-fitting screening pattern id (a screening pattern, not a diagnosis)
Next-step priority given by the checker: 0 monitor, 1 assess, 2 prompt
The acute-injury fracture screen (Ottawa-style) was triggered
Study arm in force when the assessment was sent: immediate (patient sees the screening straight away) or after_review
The screening was actually shown to the patient

outcomes.title: Outcome measures
columns: Study id: the patient's RehabVerse reference code (a random code)
Instrument id (nprs, psfs, groc, neck_rom, neck_endurance, back_function_tests, ...)
Version of the instrument's wording and scoring that was used
baseline, w1, w2, w4, w6, w12 or discharge
The number followed over time (for example the average pain over the week); empty for measurements with several values
All values: item scores or the measurements with their own names
A class the instrument defines (for example STarT Back risk group)
Language the words were shown in: en or ru. Roman Urdu is an unvalidated help beside the English wording
Days from the start of the outcome plan to the answer

daily_feedback.title: Daily exercise feedback
columns: Study id: the patient's RehabVerse reference code (a random code)
Number of warning signs ticked (their wording is not exported)

adverse_events.title: Adverse events
columns: Study id: the patient's RehabVerse reference code (a random code)
